clue.text: Ridicule attempt to conceal a piece of underclothing

indicators.note: something concealed is held inside, so the attempt word wraps around the other pieces

parts.note: an attempt is a try
a vest is an undergarment worn beneath a shirt

explanation.surface: Someone mocks an effort to hide a garment worn underneath.
explanation.definitionFit: A mockery or grotesque imitation is a form of ridicule, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Crufts winner and master

definitions.meaning: Crufts is Britain's famous dog show, so its winner is the best canine there
the one in charge, the boss who dominates everyone else

explanation.definitionFit: Literally the best hound at a dog show, and idiomatically the dominant person in a group.

clue.text: Fashions suitable to be shown in commercials

indicators.note: something shown in a programme sits inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: commercials are adverts, ads for short
apt means suitable or fitting

explanation.surface: Appropriate clothing styles appear in television adverts.
explanation.definitionFit: To fashion something is to shape or modify it, which is what adjusting it means.

clue.text: It's bigger and better than a birdie, of course

definitions.text: It's bigger and better than a birdie, of course

parts.words: It's bigger and better than a birdie, of course
parts.note: on a golf course a score two under par beats a birdie, one under; and a large raptor is bigger than a little bird

explanation.surface: Something outdoes a small bird, naturally.
explanation.definitionFit: In golf this score is two strokes under par, one better than a birdie; it is also a big bird of prey.

clue.text: People in general admit blame and it does them good

indicators.note: to admit is to let in, so the people word takes the blame word inside it

parts.note: they, as in 'they say', means people in general
rap means blame or punishment, as in 'take the rap'

explanation.surface: Folk owning up to fault find it beneficial.
explanation.definitionFit: Treatment meant to heal or help a patient is something that benefits them.

clue.text: Agent is given assistance to get debts settled

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative, an agent
aid means help or assistance

explanation.surface: A representative receives help so outstanding bills can be cleared.
explanation.definitionFit: Money owed that has been paid back counts as cleared or discharged.

clue.text: Calm and painless death

explanation.definitionFit: One word means relaxed and tolerant; split in two, it describes a gentle passing away.

clue.text: A personal account arouses hostility

parts.note: one's version is one's own account of events

explanation.surface: Someone's own story of events provokes ill feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong dislike of something is a kind of antagonism toward it.

clue.text: Diane's Michaelmas daisy turns out a complete failure

parts.note: Di is short for Diane, so Diane's gives DI'S
the Michaelmas daisy is a type of aster flower

explanation.surface: A woman's autumn flower proves a flop.
explanation.definitionFit: A catastrophe or fiasco is something that goes entirely wrong.

clue.text: He would certainly want to see an actor full of energy

definitions.text: He would certainly want to see

indicators.note: being full of something means holding it inside, so energy goes within the actor word

parts.note: a player is an actor on stage
go means energy or vigour

explanation.surface: Someone is keen to watch a vigorous performer.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatre fan who attends shows wants to watch drama, so he wants to see.

clue.text: Set a value on Roman coins before Sunday

indicators.note: one piece comes before the other in the answer

parts.note: the as was a Roman copper coin, plural asses

explanation.surface: Someone prices old Roman money ahead of the weekend.
explanation.definitionFit: To evaluate or appraise something is to put a value or price on it.

clue.text: Those who sniff it may get stuck on it

definitions.text: Those who sniff it may get stuck on it

parts.words: Those who sniff it may get stuck on it
parts.note: an adhesive solvent is abused by sniffers who become hooked, and anything placed on it is literally stuck

explanation.surface: Inhalant users can become addicted.
explanation.definitionFit: An adhesive literally makes things stick, and solvent abusers get hooked on its fumes.

clue.text: Alert batsmen have their sights set there

definitions.text: batsmen have their sights set there
definitions.meaning: in cricket a batsman keeps his eyes fixed on the delivered sphere

explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for sharp and attentive, and literally where a batter's eye stays fixed.

clue.text: Idle talk by private secretary has breathtaking results

parts.note: gas is idle chatter
PS is the abbreviation for private secretary

explanation.surface: Office gossip from the boss's assistant causes shock.
explanation.definitionFit: Sharp intakes of air are what happens when something takes one's breath away.

clue.text: Cart moved back three feet

indicators.note: moving something back here means reading the word for the measure backwards

parts.note: a yard is three feet

explanation.surface: A wagon is shifted a short distance backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A low heavy brewer's wagon is a kind of cart.

clue.text: Remember to pass the hat round again

definitions.text: to pass the hat round again
definitions.meaning: to collect money a second time

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is recall; read with a hyphen it means gather donations once more.

clue.text: Model example of an English sacred book

parts.note: pi is short for pious, holy
a tome is a large book

explanation.surface: A perfect specimen of an English holy scripture.
explanation.definitionFit: A perfect embodiment or typical instance of something is its quintessence.

clue.text: They drag their heels in producing cinema advertisements

definitions.meaning: towed vehicles follow behind, dragged along at the rear
previews of forthcoming films shown before the main feature

explanation.definitionFit: Towed wagons drag along behind, and film previews advertise upcoming releases.

clue.text: Remarked that former pupil had a job as a waiter

parts.note: OB is an old boy, a former pupil of a school

parts.words: had a job as a waiter
parts.note: a waiter served at table

explanation.surface: Someone commented that an ex-student had worked waiting tables.
explanation.definitionFit: To observe can mean to comment or state, so it matches remarked.

clue.text: Polish picture portraying the scene where Caesar burnt his bridges

definitions.text: the scene where Caesar burnt his bridges

parts.note: to rub is to polish
an icon is a picture, especially a religious one

explanation.surface: A painting depicts the moment Julius Caesar committed himself irreversibly.
explanation.walkthrough: Caesar crossed this small Italian river in 49 BC, starting civil war, and the phrase 'cross it' now means reach a point of no return.
explanation.definitionFit: The stream Caesar crossed with his army, a step from which there was no going back.

clue.text: Must be the condition of the destitute

definitions.meaning: a necessity, something one has to have
poverty, the state of the very poor

explanation.definitionFit: A requirement or necessity, and also want or poverty.

clue.text: Novelist the French embrace with love

parts.note: a hug is an embrace
love is zero in tennis, written O

explanation.surface: French people hug a writer fondly.
explanation.walkthrough: Victor Hugo, author of Les Misérables, was French, which 'the French embrace' alludes to in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Victor Hugo wrote famous novels, so he is an example of an author of fiction.

clue.text: The flower children getting their just desserts?

definitions.text: The flower children getting their just desserts?

parts.words: The flower children getting their just desserts?
parts.note: the 1960s counterculture youth, read humorously as cool tarts and pastries

explanation.surface: Sixties youths finally get what they deserve.
explanation.definitionFit: The flower-power generation of the 1960s, punningly split into trendy puddings.

clue.text: Will the camper be found there?

definitions.meaning: a camper sleeps under canvas, so he is in a tent

explanation.definitionFit: Intention or purpose is will; split in two, it is where a camper sleeps.

clue.text: In a pickle when exploited like this

definitions.meaning: steeped in brine or vinegar, or drunk
read as two words: exploited in this way

explanation.definitionFit: Pickled in brine (or drunk), and split in two it says treated in this manner.

clue.text: One type of wood which is perfect

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
deal is pine or fir timber

explanation.surface: A kind of timber that is flawless.
explanation.definitionFit: Something flawless or exemplary is the model of excellence.

clue.text: The language in which to construct neat prose

indicators.note: constructing means building something new out of these letters

explanation.surface: Someone writes elegant text in an invented tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: An artificial international tongue devised by Zamenhof in 1887.

clue.text: A riot agitating for proportional representation

indicators.note: agitating means stirring up and shaking these letters into a new order

explanation.surface: Rioters protest for a fairer voting system.
explanation.definitionFit: A numerical relationship expressing proportion, such as three to one.

clue.text: Begrudged having to compete in the final round

indicators.note: one word sits inside the other

parts.note: the end is the final stage
to vie is to compete

explanation.surface: Someone resented having to battle in the last stage of a contest.
explanation.definitionFit: Resentful longing for what someone else has is jealousy, so to resent them for it.

clue.text: I had to suffer a setback with strain and misery

indicators.note: a setback turns things back, so the short form is written backwards

parts.note: I'd is short for I had
stress is strain

explanation.surface: A narrator recalls a reverse, tension and unhappiness.
explanation.definitionFit: Anguish or suffering is extreme unhappiness.

clue.text: Unruffled, despite being teased terribly

indicators.note: terribly signals the letters are badly jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone stays calm though mocked mercilessly.
explanation.definitionFit: Calm and composed, not agitated.

clue.text: A selection of sweets is so arranged

definitions.text: A selection of sweets is so arranged

parts.words: A selection of sweets is so arranged
parts.note: a mixed box of confectionery is described as being of various sorts

explanation.surface: A box of confectionery is laid out in a certain way.
explanation.definitionFit: Mixed or varied, as in a box of different confectionery types.
